data.name: Weapon Attunement
data.description: You can attune yourself to any weapon in your possession, and can change that attunement once per day.

raw_tokens.value: You can attune yourself to any weapon in your possession, and can change that attunement once per day.
The attuned weapon gains a +1 enhancement bonus.|PREVARGTEQ:ABP_WeaponLVL,4|PREVARLT:ABP_WeaponLVL,8
You can split your attunement between two weapons, granting each a +1 enhancement bonus.|PREVARGTEQ:ABP_WeaponLVL,8|PREVARLT:ABP_WeaponLVL,9
You can either grant a single weapon a +2 enhancement bonus or grant two weapons a +1 enhancement bonus each.|PREVARGTEQ:ABP_WeaponLVL,9|PREVARLT:ABP_WeaponLVL,14
